dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular light-grey annular perimeters with jagged edges; the pixel gradient transitions sharply from a dark charcoal exterior to a high-intensity light-grey ring, with some enclosing a darker interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of localized, solid light-toned asymmetrical clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily distributed in the interstitial spaces between the larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral; three dorsal-lateral annuli form a wide-angle obtuse triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A pronounced transverse skin fold or collar is visible at the junction of the head and neck; distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the distal ends of both the lateral and tail flippers.
